title: Transport of all localization squares through short exact cochain models
statement: Let D be an abelian category. A SupportHomologyRow consists of three integer-indexed objects and arrows f^q:R1^q→R2^q, g^q:R2^q→R3^q and δ^q:R3^q→R1^(q+1). A model is a short exact sequence of cochain complexes with homology isomorphisms identifying f, g and δ with its homology maps and snake boundary. Given two such rows and specified graded comparison maps c1,c2,c3, suppose a morphism of their models induces those three maps under the isomorphisms. Then f c2=c1 f′, g c3=c2 g′ and δ c1=c3 δ′ in every integer degree, with no extra sign.

source.place: homology.tex Tags 0117 and 08N7, cochain long exact sequence and naturality of the snake boundary; explicit transport through chosen homology model isomorphisms.

proof.text: Compose the desired f and g equations on the left with the appropriate source model isomorphism. Substitute the model transport equations. Functoriality of homology turns the two cochain commutation equations into the required homology equations. Substitute the target model transport equations and cancel the isomorphism.

For the boundary square use the same transport calculation, replacing homology functoriality with the snake-boundary naturality equation for the given morphism of short exact complexes. Both boundaries are the same Mathlib ShortExact.δ convention, so this introduces no sign. Cancel the source third homology isomorphism.
